question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da5d09aa5e6f5a10848359062ba2f3fbe0343ee74c5c0f37b792f3c086fcc703.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The peripheral elements move one position in a counter-clockwise direction, and the central number increases by 3.

The first pair:

The element at the top moves to the left position.

The element on the left moves to the bottom position.

The element at the bottom moves to the right position.

The element on the right moves to the top position.
